free_tier.stated: No permanent free tier. The entry offer is a one-day trial of every feature at $0.99 (a prepaid plan); paid plans start at $9.99/month.

retention.stated: Files are held while the plan is active. When a plan ends the account is deactivated: files are kept 15 more days (no download or streaming) and then deleted for good.
retention.notes: Deleted files go to Trash and stay there for 14 days by default; Trash can be disabled in Account > Settings > Storage.

egress.terms: Downloads from put.io to a device have a monthly bandwidth cap: 1 TB on the 100G plan and 3 TB on the 1T plan, after which speed drops to 1.5 MB/s until the month resets on the first. Uploads and transfers into put.io do not count.

reliability_note: No free tier. The trial is $0.99 for 24 hours ('Try every put.io feature for a day for $0.99. Ends after 24 hours'). Does not clear even the trial bar for storage use.
